brandSummary: UrbanStride is a fictional urban walking-shoe brand for people who move through cities on foot.
positioning: Practical, design-conscious footwear for comfortable everyday city movement.
valueProposition: Comfortable walking shoes with restrained design for long days in the city.
mission: Help people explore cities comfortably and confidently.
vision: Make walking the most natural way to experience urban life.
targetAudienceSummary: Urban professionals and independent workers who walk frequently and value comfort without a technical-looking shoe.
customerProblem: Many comfortable shoes look overly athletic, while style-led shoes become uncomfortable during long city days.
brandPromise: Comfort that keeps pace with the city.
visualDirection: Clean editorial city photography, natural movement, stone and asphalt textures, restrained color accents.
typographyRecommendations: Highly readable sans for body copy
imageDirection: Realistic street-level scenes with natural daylight and visible walking movement.
reusableImagePrompt: Editorial urban footwear photograph, natural daylight, pedestrian-scale city setting, restrained navy and blue accents, realistic materials, no text, no neon effects.
keyMarketingMessages: A clean look without sacrificing comfort
